name: fporcari
description: Repository workflow plugins for pull request and issue triage, review, and execution.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: PR and issue workflow toolkit: triage skills plus a local git-desk dashboard with pluggable git hosting providers (GitHub, Forgejo).

plugins.name: desk-band
plugins.description: Claude Code mod for the git desk: a band above the prompt with every desk loop tagged PR or ISSUE in its own color — working, in background, queued, waiting for you — a toast when one needs you or finishes, and a guard on a bare "vai" when two loops wait for an answer.
